items.title: Captain Verne Streckfus Interview, 1960-09-22
items.q: That's why Mick Lala is a good cornet player. He follows his father's footsteps and his fine shape.

ctx.x: I think the kind of band, I think it's good too for the dance band. Oh, it's pretty good.

Have you heard Gito's bands even on the board? Well, it's a very full band. We've had every band in the city and I don't think we've missed any. We've had them all on special occasions. We've had them for some time, about a month and so on. And this band is a full band. And it has pretty good rhythm. And some of the people say we're too slow, some of the real slow drives, we're just a little bit too slow. But we haven't seen anything about it. It takes a lot of let it go along for a while. Just make sure that…
He's got quite a teaching band. You know, he's got three teachers in the band. You teach two? No. The lead sax man is a history teacher. The middle fellow.
